heroHeadline: Russia Escalates Energy-Grid Campaign as Putin Rules Out Ceasefire
heroSubtitle: Russian drones hit Kyiv's Academy of Sciences and a Dnipro office centre on September 28, killing at least 7. A massive combined strike on energy infrastructure followed, including a thermal power plant in Kyiv region, and Dnipro bridges in Kyiv were targeted on October 2. Putin explicitly ruled out any ceasefire in a Moscow speech on October 1, and Ukrainian intelligence warns of further mass missile strikes on October 2-3.
